title: Growing Network
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 200000 computers, m ≤ 300000 link events in chronological order, each adding one connection. After each event, report the number of connected components.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Run BFS after every event

**B)** DSU with union-by-size; components = n minus successful unions

**C)** Kruskal, then binary search each query

**D)** Sparse table over events

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Edges are only added and the question is connectivity — DSU amortizes all m unions in near-linear time; components decrease by one per merge.
